description: This file defines API routes for analytics computations in a FastAPI-based backend, including a POST endpoint that processes session data to generate aggregated analytics based on a specified timeframe.

classes.name: AnalyticsQuery
classes.description: Input data model for analytics query parameters such as project ID, task ID, date range, and timeframe.

classes.name: AnalyticsResponse
classes.description: Output data model containing total minutes, total earnings, and aggregated buckets of data.

classes.name: AggregatedBucket
classes.description: Data model representing aggregated totals for a specific key (e.g., date or week).

classes.name: Timeframe
classes.description: Enum defining the timeframe granularity for aggregation: daily, weekly, or monthly.

methods.name: AnalyticsResponse compute_analytics(query: AnalyticsQuery)
methods.description: FastAPI endpoint to compute and return analytics based on the provided query parameters.

methods.name: str _bucket_key(dt: datetime, timeframe: Timeframe)
methods.description: Helper function that generates a key string for bucketing data based on the timeframe.
